data_provenance: Verified via web search (Sep 2026): IIM Indore official CAT 2026 press release/notification, cross-checked against multiple test-prep trackers. Pattern has been stable (68Q/120min/3-section sectional-time-lock) since CAT 2020.
important_caveat: IIMs can revise exact section counts/timing each year; a couple of sources still cite the pre-2024 20-DILR-question figure, so 22 (this file's figure) should be re-confirmed against the CAT 2026 official mock once released. No official syllabus is ever published for CAT - only the pattern (sections/timing/marking) is official.

exam_day.note: Single day, three slots (morning/afternoon/evening); each candidate sits one slot only.

structure.overall_difficulty: DILR typically the most time-pressured/toughest to finish; QA and VARC difficulty varies by slot

VARC.composition: ~16 RC questions (4 passages x 4) + ~8 non-RC verbal-ability questions

DILR.composition: ~5 sets of 4-5 linked questions each, mixing data-interpretation and logical-reasoning caselets

QA.composition: Arithmetic and Algebra together ~70% of the section; remainder Geometry/Mensuration and Modern Math

quick_comparison.value: 120 minutes total, 40 minutes per section (strict, non-transferable)
VARC, DILR, QA - fixed order, no switching back
MCQ (4 options, -1 for wrong) and TITA (typed numeric/text answer, no negative marking)
DILR most time-constrained; no officially fixed easy/moderate/hard split, varies by slot
